narratives.today: Today's lowest price is €0.23 at 13:00 and the peak is €0.46 at 19:00. Your battery is charging at 72% and today's solar is on track for about 9.5 kWh, so the afternoon is largely covered.
narratives.tomorrow: Tomorrow brings much less sun than today: 2.2 kWh against 8.18 kWh, so the house will lean on the grid and prices are usually firmer in that case; a better picture follows once tomorrow's prices are published.
narratives.fri: Friday looks like the week's weakest solar day at 2.29 kWh. With rain expected, it is not a good day to run your large appliances.
narratives.sun: Sunday looks the best for solar: score 26 and 10.87 kWh expected.
